ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) with approximately 15% high-intensity (white/grey) pixel coverage across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Low-intensity (black) base with high-intensity (white) clusters concentrated at the distal tips. Scattered small-scale circular and linear high-contrast blobs are distributed non-uniformly across both lobes, with a distinct high-intensity cluster at the central peduncle junction.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated narrow V-shaped depression at the center-line; vertex angle approximately 35-45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the superior margins; macro-level irregularity and jagged pixel variance observed at the lateral terminal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the upper trailing edges, tapering to acute, upward-oriented lateral points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of numerous circular, high-contrast white ring-like pixel clusters (approx. 20+ units) concentrated in the medial regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple white linear pixel disruptions visible; prominent set of four parallel diagonal marks on the right lobe and several non-aligned streaks on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavily textured and eroded distal tips on both lobes with exposed high-intensity white pixel clusters, indicating significant structural degradation at the lateral extremities.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense cluster of high-intensity white pixels located at the central base where the fluke meets the peduncle.
